newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank one-day repo rate 12.08 pct (16.32 pct).
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank one-day repo rate 12.08 pct (16.32 pct).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday the average rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender fell to 12.08 percent, from 16.32 percent in the last similar tender on Wednesday.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 4.0 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered in Wednesday's tender. It added bids totalled 5.51 billion crowns.
The maximum bid in the tender was 14.00 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 11.0 percent, the NBS added.
Last Friday, the NBS's three-day average repo rate rose to a record high of 21.2 percent.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 93.61 percent as of Wednesday, after being at 91.34 percent the previous day.
